Vietnamese reader locale

Tiếng Việt — the vi reader pack. Script: Latin (Vietnamese); direction: left-to-right.

FieldValue
Locale codevi
Native nameTiếng Việt
ScriptLatin (Vietnamese)
Directionleft-to-right

Latin script, but not English — the control case. Heavy diacritics stress NFKC equivalence, and multi-word keywords join with underscores (bắt_đầu).

English ↔ Vietnamese#

Generated from the packs; read a row across to translate one term. The Latin column is the pack key, which keys the keyword reference.
